title: Python console phase 2: live input, files and exercises
summary: Audited existing browser and native runtimes. Implementing browser live prompts, controlled execution sessions, practice files, isolated exercise checks and mobile keyboard improvements.

changes.detail: Parent-owned execution controller with cumulative execution, input-wait and wall deadlines; JSPI live input bridge with buffered fallback; practice-file and exercise models.
Browser runtime accepts bounded 64,000-character scripts and bounded streaming snapshots while preserving the opaque-origin iframe and disposable worker.

validation.name: Implementation pending
validation.detail: Live input requires browser JSPI. Native/runtime/editor integration and real browser tests remain pending. No deployment or production backend execution.
